scope: Only missing saved-artifact CPU diagnostics and review packaging; no models, raw inputs or fits
example_rule: For each controlled fine-tuning pair and each within-fold failure rank-direction combination, take at most two with largest visual rank displacement; ties sample_id. Percentile ranks use average ties; exact zero means unchanged.
aggregation: Pooled weighted AP with original saved recording multiplicities and recording order; percentile95 using numpy default linear quantiles. Newly added contrasts exploratory.
